artworks.title: Newport Mountain from Bald Porcupine
artworks.medium: black and white chalk and watercolor on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a tranquil scene with a calm body of water and sailboats in the distance. A gently sloping hillside leads down to the water. A horizon line runs through the middle of the image, with a ridge of hills in the distance. The brushstrokes are delicate, creating a soft texture. The colors are muted, including grays, greens, browns, and gentle blues.

artworks.title: Suffer the Little Children
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals in a room with a central figure - a man seated on an elevated seat with a child on his lap. The man has dark hair and a beard, wearing a white robe with a red garment on his seat. The crowd around him consists of mostly men in earthy-toned clothing. One figure in the foreground has his hand on the child. The background has a soft, architectural setting, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: gouache and watercolor over touches of graphite on paper mount on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows an older man seated, holding a green book in his left hand against his knee. His right hand is holding the book open. He appears to have a fair complexion, grey wavy hair, and is dressed in a dark suit with a white shirt and cravat. He has a slight smile and is looking directly at the viewer. The background is a simple, muted brownish tone.

artworks.title: Nile Journey, Esneh, Egypt
artworks.medium: black chalk on folded blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with figures on the left side and on horseback under a tree on the right side. The horizon is low, aligning with the heads of the figures on foot. Loose brushstrokes or charcoal markings create a sketch-like appearance. The color palette is limited to shades of black, gray, and pale blue. Shadowing partially obscures closer figures, while distant ones are simplified.

artworks.title: The Dalles of St. Louis
artworks.medium: graphite (stumping in areas) and pen and black  ink heightened with white
artworks.description: The image shows a flowing river cutting through a misty forest. The perspective is slightly elevated, with loose and gestural brushstrokes capturing the movement of the water and textures of the trees. The color palette is muted and earthy, featuring shades of gray, brown, white, and black. The foreground has a rocky riverbank with leafless trees, while dense tree formations in the misty background are softly diffused.

artworks.title: Study for "The Bailey Family"
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite with touches of pen and black ink
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior room with a large fireplace. The scene presents a dimly-lit interior setting featuring an ornate fireplace which appears to be the focal point of the room. The room contains architectural details like paneling on the walls and a mantelpiece, along with intricately carved chairs and other furnishings. The textures and forms are rendered through delicate brushstrokes and shading. The painting predominantly uses a monochromatic palette in shades of gray to emphasize a serene mood. The style is reminiscent of Rembrandt, known for fine detail and use of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Wood Interior
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a view under a forest canopy where leafless trees are seen, with the horizon obscured by dense layers of trees. The style is impressionistic, with soft pencil strokes capturing the branches on the left and evergreen foliage on the right. The color palette is various shades of gray, creating a muted and serene appearance. Trees close by have defined strokes, while those in the distance blur into softer lines, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: St. Kitts
artworks.description: The image displays a sketched mountainous landscape from a low perspective, highlighting the towering peaks. The horizon is subtly depicted with a thin line blending into the mountain forms. Loose and fluid brushstrokes outline the contours with light and dark areas indicating shadows and ridges. The color scheme is minimalistic, mainly gray on a cream background, accentuating the mountain's shapes and textures. The distant mountains rise elegantly, while those nearest expand horizontally, guiding the viewer's gaze.

artworks.title: St. Vincent
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white pencil sketch of a mountainous landscape viewed from above. The mountains create a boundary between land and sky. The sketch depicts rugged slopes and sharp peaks with varying pencil stroke intensity and thickness to show depth and texture. The monochromatic palette uses variations of black on white paper. The hills close to us have pronounced contours, while distant peaks are softer and less defined. Some ridges have sparse indications of foliage.

artworks.title: Ogunquit Fisherman
artworks.description: The image shows a boat with gestural strokes, a lone figure on it, a horizon with dark shapes indicating waves or landforms, and a sky. The artwork appears to be created with graphite or charcoal on neutral-toned paper with a monochromatic palette.

artworks.title: Engine Trouble
artworks.medium: black crayon on wove spiral-bound wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a body of water with two boats. One boat is a small canoe-like vessel with a single figure rowing, while a larger boat is positioned higher in the composition. The horizon is not clearly defined. The boats and figures are drawn with expressive strokes, likely using charcoal or pencil, creating a dynamic feel. The color palette is minimal, using shades of grey and black on a beige paper.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene with a central figure bearing a crown of thorns and carrying a wooden cross, surrounded by four other figures. The central figure appears to be in suffering, marked by a halo and a crown of thorns. The four surrounding figures have expressive features and are engaging with the central figure. The work has a muted color palette with earthy tones, accented by reds and greens. The texture of the background and clothing is achieved through meticulous cross-hatching and linework, adding depth to the woodcut print style. The bottom of the image includes a block of text with multiple lines. This is in the style of an early European woodcut, reminiscent of artists known for detailed print work.

artworks.title: Mountain Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a bird's-eye view of a mountainous landscape with tall trees, rocky cliffs, small buildings in the distance, and an elevated structure on a cliff. The drawing is intricate, detailed, and monochromatic, resembling a pen or ink sketch.

artworks.title: Venice
artworks.medium: etching with gray wash on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20 x 29.5 cm (7 7/8 x 11 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius L. and Anita Zelman Fund
artworks.description: This image captures a scene looking across a body of water towards a city skyline. The horizon is low in the composition, aligning with the distant line where the city meets the sky. Various buildings and structures, including a prominent domed architecture, dot the horizon. The artwork features delicate, sketchy lines, giving an impression of lightness and fluidity. The color palette is minimal, showcasing natural tones of pencil or charcoal on off-white paper with subtle variations in shading creating depth and texture. Closest to us are several wooden poles in the water, while in the distance, small boats float near the city landscape.

artworks.title: Funeral Monument to the Daughters of Feuerabend
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical crucifixion scene. Jesus is depicted on the cross with two other figures, set against a detailed landscape with onlookers and soldiers. Surrounding the central scene are oval panels of figures in religious attire, bordered by scrollwork, cherubs, and Latin text. At the bottom, there are additional decorative motifs and supporting figures.

artworks.title: Allegory of Poverty Hindering Wit
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a contrapposto pose, with his weight on the right leg and left leg slightly bent. His left arm is extended upwards with a bird perched on the back of his hand, and his right arm holds a strap wrapped around a large rock. The man has a bushy beard, curly hair, a neutral expression, and is looking up at his raised hand. He is wearing draped clothing over one shoulder and tied around his waist, revealing a muscular torso. There is a small tree stump and grass around his feet, with a plain background.

artworks.title: Erna Lying on the Beach among Rocks
artworks.description: The image is a minimalistic line drawing of a nude figure lying on their side. The figure is stretched out horizontally with their head turned towards the viewer. The hair is depicted with simple lines. There are no clothes, jewelry, or objects in the drawing. The background shows semi-circular shapes resembling an abstract landscape against a blank backdrop.

artworks.title: Bouquet d'arbres au ruisseau (Stand of Trees on a River)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view with trees and foliage. The horizon is low in the background. Trees with detailed branches and leaves dominate the scene. The artwork features fine etching with precise strokes that vary in density, adding depth. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown. A stream or path winds through the scene, flanked by shrubbery and undergrowth. The landscape continues with more vegetation in the distance.

artworks.title: Title-Border with Putti Holding the Pirckheimer Arms
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decorative border featuring cherubs, columns, and floral motifs. The image includes a rectangular blank space in the center, bordered by intricate patterns and designs. The top and sides display floral and vegetative forms, including grapes and scrolling vines. On the left, a long-necked bird is depicted among the foliage. On the right, a figure is shown playing a pan flute on top of a classical column. At the bottom, two cherubic figures hold a coat of arms featuring a stylized flower emblem. The artwork is detailed, combining classical and natural elements harmoniously.

artworks.title: Head of an Elderly Woman with Upturned Eyes
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 19.5 x 14.4 cm (7 11/16 x 5 11/16 in.)
support: 21.2 x 15.2 cm (8 3/8 x 6 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a detailed portrait of an individual from the head to the upper shoulders, almost entirely front-facing. The person's head is slightly tilted upwards. The drawing showcases distinct facial features, including deep-set eyes looking upwards, pronounced cheekbones, and slightly parted lips. The shading emphasizes wrinkles and expressions on the face. The individual has long, straight hair that falls over their shoulders and frames their face. They are depicted wearing a garment over their head and shoulders. The drawing is monochromatic, likely created using pencil or charcoal, adding texture to the hair and fabric. The background is plain. The bottom left corner bears the inscription "A. Caselli," while the number "32" is noted in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: The Falconer
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.9 × 7.2 cm (3 1/2 × 2 13/16 in.)
support: 9.4 × 7.8 cm (3 11/16 × 3 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a person riding a horse. The person is seated on the horse with their profile visible. They have a feathered hat, and their facial features are partially obscured. The person's hair is tied back and fits under the hat. They are dressed in a garment with gathered sleeves and wear a cape over their shoulders. A large tree is near the rider, and in the background, another figure on horseback is visible. Both riders are shown with detailed linework capturing the horses' form and motion. The scene is set in an open, illustrated landscape with minimal ground details and distant trees.

artworks.title: A Spaniel Jumping
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dog. The dog is depicted in mid-movement, with a mix of dark and light tones in its coat. The dog's head is lifted upwards, and the background includes tall grass and a tree with a broken trunk. The shading and tone create a warm atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Federico Barocci
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures surrounding a central reclining figure. The composition features dramatic drapery and emotive expressions. Surrounding the central figure are several individuals engaged in gestures suggesting mourning or contemplation. The scene is set against a backdrop featuring trees, a large cross under construction, and castle-like structures. In the foreground, various objects like a hammer, pliers, a crown of thorns, and nails are depicted. The bottom of the image contains an elaborate coat of arms with Latin inscriptions. The details and shading create a visually complex and expressive narrative scene.

artworks.title: Two Angels Holding a Coat of Arms
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over chalk on two joined sheets
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-bodied figures standing in a pose facing each other. Both figures have detailed facial features, voluminous hair, and large wings. They wear elaborate clothing and are barefoot. Between them is a decorative crest or shield with heraldic symbols. They stand on an ornately carved pedestal. The background is a simple surface.
